indexes.name: incidents_lifecycle_opened_idx
indexes.sql: CREATE INDEX incidents_lifecycle_opened_idx ON incidents(lifecycle, opened_at DESC)

indexes.name: incidents_active_work_idx
indexes.sql:
CREATE INDEX incidents_active_work_idx
  ON incidents(id) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND lifecycle <> 'Resolved'

indexes.name: incidents_unresolved_work_idx
indexes.sql:
CREATE INDEX incidents_unresolved_work_idx
  ON incidents(id) WHERE resolved_at IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

indexes.name: incidents_report_due_idx
indexes.sql:
CREATE INDEX incidents_report_due_idx
  ON incidents(peak_impact, resolved_at, id) WHERE lifecycle = 'Resolved' AND deleted_at IS NULL

indexes.name: incidents_resolved_public_window
indexes.sql:
CREATE INDEX incidents_resolved_public_window
  ON incidents(resolved_at DESC,id DESC) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND lifecycle='Resolved'

indexes.name: incidents_public_archive_seek
indexes.sql: CREATE INDEX incidents_public_archive_seek ON incidents(opened_at DESC,id DESC) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
